summary: Model validation and governance professional with ~7 years across pension ALM, investment risk analytics, and quantitative model development, applying for the Senior Director, Model Validation role at HOOPP. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios at Moody's Analytics ($5–25bn per engagement). Validates pricing, investment, and actuarial-liability models; reviews AI/ML-assisted analytical workflows. CFA and dual MSc (Financial Modelling; Engineering).

sections.heading: Independent Validation & Conceptual Soundness Review
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios — $5–25bn per engagement, ~$50bn+ cumulative — independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; cross-check sensitivity consistency and implementation accuracy at portfolio-level investment and ALM aggregates.

Evaluate conceptual soundness, methodological rigor, and economic defensibility of model outputs; escalate outputs that pass internal checks but fail economic-defensibility standards, serving as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Model Governance, Documentation & Performance Monitoring
bullets: Operate within a formal model-governance framework — assumption validation, change-control review, documentation standards, and ongoing performance monitoring consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 model-risk-management expectations.

Prepare model risk summaries for senior stakeholders covering interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative outputs into committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Model Development & AI/ML-Assisted Validation Workflows
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across investment and liability horizons, with embedded behavioral assumptions and macro stress overlays.

Developed agentic AI workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) to automate first-pass validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation — human sign-off retained on all governance-critical review steps; estimated 30–40% reduction in development and review cycle time on comparable modules.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and reconciliation controls.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform — advised on asset, liability, and ALM configurations; validated model outputs post-deployment.

Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and Product Owners, translating requirements into development requests and challenging configuration choices against model and data-quality expectations.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — advised actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on adoption, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness processes.
Contributed subject-matter input to IFRS 17 product offerings and implementation collateral, coordinating across multidisciplinary teams on milestone delivery.
Built and validated stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base and stressed regimes for Canadian and international pension funds.

Modelled pension actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types and economic variables; conducted funding-ratio, duration-gap, and LDI analysis informing Strategic Asset Allocation recommendations.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR via Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, attribution, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.

Led the ALM study and model build for a three-plan university pension merger (new jointly-sponsored plan) — on a team of three developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics, duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlays; presented findings to investment committees on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
